items.headline: Wind Advisory issued July 21 at 3:58AM AKDT until July 22 at 9:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 55 mph expected.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp and Eastern
Alaska Range South of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...From 7 PM this evening to 9 AM AKDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp; Eastern Alaska Range South of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.description:

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 20 at 12:57PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
We are monitoring the potential for a coastal storm around
Thursday of this week. There is high uncertainty with the track of
the storm as it could be anywhere from the Yukon Delta to Bering
Strait. Fortunately, it doesn't appear to be a storm that would
come with major impacts. However, there is a chance for minor
coastal impacts and high surf due to gusty southeast winds during
the first half of the storm, then west-northwest winds as the low
